history_policy: This version hash-inherits every V44 workload, representation, width, job count, checksum, execution mode, scored operation, attribution counter, mixed-tier replay signature, timing boundary, occupancy rule, binary-provenance profile, publication ruling, process classification, and memory-pressure diagnostic. It changes no scored row or execution boundary. It versions the tier-attribution sidecar from schema 15 to 16 and the owned-memory inventory from schema 3 to 4 solely to publish exact JSON.stringify frame-cache overlap gauges. Any later workload, boundary, jobs, checksum, metric source, adapter, integration ruling, diagnostic schema, process policy, or publication change needs its own version.
change: Adds exact current/peak cache count, frame-capacity, owned-byte, capacity-growth, capacity-release, and released-frame-byte gauges for reusable JSON.stringify continuation storage. The gauges overlap Context backing and never enter accounted-owned-byte totals, scored timing, phase deltas, allocation replay, or publication acceptance.

memory_inventory_diagnostics.reconciliation: JSON.stringify frame-cache current bytes are a named overlap within Context backing, peak/current cache and frame gauges are monotonic/coherent, zero current cache count requires zero current capacity and bytes, and the disjoint owned-byte subtotal remains unchanged
memory_inventory_diagnostics.publication_boundary: The cache gauges diagnose retained continuation working sets only. They do not enter elapsed-time scores, phase deltas, exact allocation replay signatures, performance ratios, stability decisions, or publication acceptance.
